purpose: Public FiveM map resources with links to their original releases.

items.name: Legion Square +
items.author: zinpod (0breezy0)
items.description: A standalone YMAP redesign of Legion Square with new landscaping and props.
requirements: Put the breezy_legionplus folder under the server’s resources directory and add ensure breezy_legionplus to server.cfg.
Test it with other Legion Square maps disabled first so you can spot overlapping props or collision.
items.previewCaption: Screenshot from the creator’s Legion Square + release.

items.name: Coin’s Sandy Shores Project
items.author: Coin6969
items.description: A Sandy Shores YMAP with new props, memorials and changes to roadside scenery.
requirements: Install the CoinsSandyProject folder that contains fxmanifest.lua and start that resource from server.cfg.
The author built this on the earlier CoinsTrees map. Compare it on its own before combining it with other Sandy Shores edits.

items.name: Omozan
items.author: AndreIakko
items.description: A custom map from AndreIakko’s free MLO collection. The repository also contains vehicle and outfit resources in separate folders.
requirements: For the map, install iak_omozan_map with its manifest and stream directory together. Start the resource on a test server.
Review the vehicle and outfit folders separately if you want to use those parts of the release.

items.name: bob74_ipl
items.author: Bob74 and contributors
items.description: A map utility for loading and customizing existing GTA V interiors and fixing missing map elements.
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Check for an existing copy
requirements: Check whether your framework already includes bob74_ipl. Use the release archive named bob74_ipl.zip and start the resource from server.cfg.
Use the upstream changelog to confirm your build and edition. The project documents separate streaming assets for Enhanced.
